reuse_modes.project_internal: Repository material that may be reused under this project's licenses.
reuse_modes.statement_adapted_proof_reconstructed: Mathematical statements and organization may guide the catalog, but Peano proofs are independently reconstructed and kernel-checked.
reuse_modes.reference_only_clean_room: Use only as a bibliographic or topic reference; do not copy prose, proof text, or code.
reuse_modes.algorithm_index_clean_room: Use as an index of algorithms and examples; implementations and formal proofs must be independently written.
reuse_modes.open_tex_reference: Openly licensed TeX may be cited and consulted as a mathematical reference; no source is vendored into this catalog.
